name: Hotel Martinez
insider_take: This Art Deco legend has been the crown jewel of La Croisette since 1929, hosting Hollywood royalty and film festival glamour for nearly a century.
whats_special: The Martinez boasts the largest private beach in Cannes and houses the legendary La Palme d'Or restaurant, one of only two Michelin two-starred establishments on the French Riviera. Its penthouse suite, where Grace Kelly once stayed, offers 180-degree Mediterranean views and is considered one of Europe's most exclusive accommodations.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view room on floors 5-7 during the Cannes Film Festival for the perfect vantage point to spot celebrities on the red carpet at the Palais des Festivals, just 200 meters away.
dont_miss: The hotel's private beach Z Plage, where Brigitte Bardot was photographed countless times, and sunset cocktails at the rooftop bar overlooking the Bay of Cannes. The Martinez also features original 1930s frescoes in its lobby that survived WWII when the hotel served as a hospital.
pros: Prime beachfront location on La Croisette in Cannes
Art Deco elegance with luxurious accommodations
Michelin-starred dining at La Palme d'Or restaurant
Exclusive Hyatt Privé benefits and personalized service
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive Cannes location
High-profile location attracts celebrity clientele and paparazzi
